definitions.explanation: Text or writing in the English language.
The study of English literature (often as an academic subject).

notes:
USAGE: {英文|えいぶん} can refer to any text written in English or to English literature as an academic field.

COMPOUNDS:
- {英文|えいぶん}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (English literature - academic)
- {英文|えいぶん}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (English composition/grammar)
- {英文|えいぶん}⟦{科|か}→科：noentry⟧ (English department)
